# cachefly_edge_control_library_script (Data Source)

Reads a script from the edge control script library: a `SYSTEM` script curated by CacheFly or one of the account's own `USER` scripts. Use `code` to deploy it with `cachefly_edge_control_script`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cachefly_edge_control_library_script" "example" {
  id = "65f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}

# Deploy a library script to a service
resource "cachefly_edge_control_script" "from_library" {
  service_id = "681b3dc52715310035cb75d4"
  kind       = data.cachefly_edge_control_library_script.example.kind
  script     = data.cachefly_edge_control_library_script.example.code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the library script.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) JavaScript source of the script.
- `created_at` (String) When the library script was created.
- `kind` (String) Kind of script (REQUEST or RESPONSE).
- `name` (String) Name of the library script.
- `type` (String) Ownership type of the script (USER or SYSTEM).
- `updated_at` (String) When the library script was last updated.
